description: Implementation of the SceneSet plugin class, managing app lifecycle, initialization, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: A plugin class managing scene references and app lifecycle within WPEFramework.

methods.name: SceneSet::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up app manager, and starts reference app.

methods.name: SceneSet::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: SceneSet::OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events.

methods.name: SceneSet::StartReferenceApp
methods.description: Launches the reference application via AppManager.

methods.name: SceneSet::RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference app if it crashes.
